title: Product sorting on the inventory page
description: Users must be able to sort the products on the inventory page by name and by price. The list must reorder immediately after a sort option is selected.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to sort products so that I can find items faster.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Sorting by name A to Z lists products in ascending alphabetical order.
2. Sorting by name Z to A lists products in descending alphabetical order.
3. Sorting by price low to high lists the cheapest product first.
4. Sorting by price high to low lists the most expensive product first.
